name: Magento 2 Codespace
onCreateCommand: bash -lc 'sudo a2enmod rewrite && sudo service apache2 restart || true'
postCreateCommand:
bash -lc '
 php -v && composer -V && node -v && npm -v &&
 if [ -f composer.json ]; then composer install; fi &&
 if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi &&
 echo "
Devcontainer ready.
- Web: https://$CODESPACE_NAME-8080.app.github.dev/
- MySQL: mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 3306 -u magento -pmagento magento
- OpenSearch: http(s)://$CODESPACE_NAME-9200.app.github.dev/"'
